# QualityReportRow

## Properties

Name | Type | Description | Notes
------------ | ------------- | ------------- | -------------
**Id** | **string** | Identifier of this persisted quality-report row. Generated by Tsuga when report rows are stored. Returned on every row. Treat it as an opaque ID. | 
**ReportId** | **string** | Identifier shared by rows from the same report generation for the same team or global cluster-wide scope. Generated by Tsuga when the report is stored. Returned on every row. | 
**RuleId** | **string** | Stable key for the telemetry-quality rule evaluated by this row. Set by Tsuga from the quality-rule catalog. Returned on every row. The enum may grow as Tsuga adds rules; clients should display unknown future values as opaque rule keys if they do not have local labels. | 
**Owner** | Pointer to **string** | Team identifier this row applies to. Set to the owning team ID for team-scoped rules. Returned for team rows; omitted for global cluster-wide rows. | [optional] 
**Status** | **string** | Evaluation outcome for this rule row. Set by the rule evaluator when the report is generated. Returned on every row. Allowed values are passed, failed, and ignored; ignored means the rule was not applicable to the available data. | 
**Score** | **float32** | Normalized score for this rule row. Set by the rule evaluator when the report is generated. Returned on every row. Values are between 0 and 1. | 
**Weight** | **float32** | Impact weight of this rule, captured at report-generation time. Set by Tsuga from the rule&#39;s impact label: 1 for normal, 2 for important, 3 for critical. Used with score to compute reportOverallScore. | 
**ReportOverallScore** | **float32** | Aggregate score for this row&#39;s report group. Calculated by Tsuga from non-ignored rows in the same team or global cluster-wide report. Returned on every row in that group with the same value. | 
**ReportTotalWeight** | **float32** | Sum of non-ignored rule weights for this row&#39;s report group. Calculated by Tsuga when the report is generated. Returned on every row in that group with the same value. | 
**Recommendation** | Pointer to **string** | Recommendation stored with this row. Set by the rule evaluator when the report is generated. Returned when a recommendation was persisted; omitted otherwise. The latest-report endpoint does not recompute or default it at read time. | [optional] 
**Examples** | Pointer to [**[]QualityReportRowExamplesInner**](QualityReportRowExamplesInner.md) | Assets, logs, metrics, or links supporting this rule result. Set by the rule evaluator when the report is generated. Returned when examples were persisted and visible to the caller; global row examples are returned only to admin users. Truncated to the first 10; compare against exampleCount to detect truncation. | [optional] 
**ExampleCount** | Pointer to **int32** | Total number of examples persisted for this row, before the preview truncation applied to examples. Returned whenever examples are visible to the caller. | [optional] 
**EvaluatedAt** | Pointer to **string** | ISO timestamp at which the rule evaluator produced this result. Set to the report generation time unless the evaluation failed during that generation; the row then carries the last successful result for the same rule and scope, and evaluatedAt is when that result was computed. Omitted when the rule has never been evaluated successfully for this scope, in which case status is ignored, and on rows stored before Tsuga recorded this timestamp. | [optional] 
**CreatedAt** | **string** | ISO timestamp the row was generated at |
